instruction: Configure VS Code to hide .git folders from the file explorer sidebar.

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring VS Code to exclude .git folders from the file explorer. Evaluator verifies that the settings.json file contains the correct files.exclude configuration for .git folders. Uses existing check_json_settings metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly fetches the VS Code user settings file from /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json using vm_file getter
Metric function check_json_settings properly validates JSON settings with exact key-value matching
Expected value {"files.exclude": {"**/.git": true}} is semantically correct for hiding .git folders in VS Code
Complete coverage: instruction requires hiding .git folders, evaluator checks exactly this requirement
Proper edge case handling: metric handles missing files, JSON parse errors, and distinguishes missing keys from None values
Data flow is correct: get_rule returns rules dict, metric accesses expected['expected'] to extract settings to verify

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
